name: Order of Hermes
description: The society of Hermetic magi, the most powerful workers of magic the world has known; this book explores integrating it into medieval society as a Fourth Estate.

name: Fourth Estate
description: Proposed end state in which the Order of Hermes becomes a recognized estate of society alongside clergy, nobility and commoners, with legal rights and obligations.

name: Four Estates
description: Division of Mythic Europe into those who pray, rule and toil (Church, nobility, peasants/townsfolk), to which the Order would add a fourth.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica, a recognizable medieval world in 1220 that Hermetic magi have power to transform.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The body of Hermetic law whose interpretation, especially regarding interference with mundanes, shapes how the Order can engage with society.

name: Oath of Hermes
description: The oath sworn by every magus, which supersedes Tribunal and Grand Tribunal rulings and forbids interfering in mundane affairs as interpreted.

name: Peripheral Code
description: The body of Tribunal rulings interpreting the Oath; magi may seek its clarification or amendment to permit engagement with mundanes.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: The Order-wide council held every 33 years at Durenmar, attended by three representatives per Tribunal and the twelve Primi; its rulings supersede local law.

name: Tribunal
description: Regional council of magi held every seven years where cases of interference are judged and the Peripheral Code clarified or amended.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House responsible for interpreting the Code of Hermes; it holds the Oath and Code at its heart and is split between Traditionalists and Transitionalists.

name: Traditionalists
description: Faction within House Guernicus holding that local Tribunals govern only their Peripheral Code, that the Order is a loose society of equals, and likely opposing a Fourth Estate.

name: Transitionalists
description: Faction within House Guernicus favoring adaptable local laws and policing powers for Quaesitores, likely welcoming the Fourth Estate.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigators and judges who enforce the Code; Transitionalists would grant them policing powers.

name: Saga Speed
description: Rules concept for the pace of a saga (slow, fast, pulsed) affecting how transformations manifest in play.

name: Pulsed Saga
description: A saga style alternating detailed stories with passages of several years, ideal for sagas of transformation.

name: Kingdom of Prester John
description: Legendary realm of medieval fable used as a tonal model for an island-of-magicians saga.

name: Voyages of John de Mandeville
description: Medieval fable cited as a tonal model for a high-fantasy island saga.

name: Catharism
description: Religious movement cited as a historical model for the spread of ideas.

name: Shepherd's Crusade
description: Historical popular movement cited as inspiration for the spread of an idea through society.

name: Antagonists
description: Ars Magica supplement presenting characters such as Giraud Le Cornu, Geoffroi D'Arques, Bishop Orris, Joseph of Napoli and Galatea.

name: Giraud Le Cornu
description: A baron from Antagonists representing the Order drawing closer to the mundane and nobles' interest in the supernatural.

name: Geoffroi D'Arques
description: A baron from Antagonists representing the nobility's rising interest in the supernatural.

name: Bishop Orris
description: Churchman from Antagonists representing the Church's strong distrust of magic and the Order.

name: Joseph of Napoli
description: Reforming churchman from Antagonists keen to bring the Order into the Church; ideal counterpart for a Hermetic proctor at the papal curia.

name: Galatea
description: Maga of House Guernicus from Antagonists who may watch the covenant for crimes.

name: Cost of Breaking Convention
description: Optional guideline imposing a -1 social penalty on magi who dress above their station or flaunt familiars.

name: The Gift
description: The magical talent of magi, whose unsettling effect makes Gentle-Gifted advisers preferable for nobles.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Virtue whose bearers lack the Gift's unsettling effect, making them suitable advisers to kings and proctors.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Hermetic ritual preserving youthful vigor, raising questions about magi's feudal service; leper magi of Tytalus specialize in it.

name: Familiar
description: A magus's bonded animal companion, whose ownership may conflict with laws restricting certain beasts.

name: Grog
description: Covenant servants and soldiers whose feudal military service obligations are unclear.

name: Covenant
description: Communities of magi; under the Fourth Estate they become legal entities and liege lords with vassals.

name: Laboratory Text
description: Written record of lab work; making practical ones widely available lets younger magi craft devices for society.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power; claiming vis sources raises questions of mundane ownership, and it is the medium of Transylvanian Hermetic taxes.

name: Join or Die
description: The Order's nominal policy toward other workers of magic, problematic because mundane authorities see such killings as murder.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Tremere-dominated Tribunal with the trappings of a Hermetic state: Coeris at its head, vis taxes, stratified magi and oppida.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House that structures the Transylvanian Tribunal as a state and broadly supports exchanging rights for responsibilities.

name: Coeris
description: The covenant at the head of the Transylvanian Hermetic state.

name: Oppidum
description: Transylvanian term for what other Tribunals call covenants; able to specialize with needs met by the state.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose Peripheral Code accepts magi living in cities and provides guidance on their conduct.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: Recovering Tribunal with a well-defined structure and its own view on mundane relations shaped by occupation.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House with fractured opinions and two primi sharing one vote; home of the leper magi aegroti.

name: Covenant Hooks
description: Covenant-level story features (e.g. Castle, Road, Urban) that draw covenants into mundane affairs.

name: Story Flaw
description: Character Flaws that generate stories, used to draw magi into mundane society.

name: Alienable Land
description: Covenant Hook: covenant lands may be sold or mortgaged to outsiders, drawing in the mundane world.

name: Beholden
description: Covenant Hook: the covenant is beholden to nobles or clergy.

name: Castle
description: Covenant Hook/Boon: the covenant occupies a castle, concerning regional nobles.

name: Dumping Ground
description: Covenant Hook: covenant cares for old and infirm nobles, risking interference charges if magic restores them.

name: Fosterage
description: Covenant Hook: magi educate a young noble, potentially spreading acceptance of Hermetic magic; also a way to seal supernatural alliances.

name: Heavy Cavalry
description: Covenant Boon: the covenant maintains a mounted military force requiring good relations with neighbors.

name: Mundane Politics
description: Covenant Hook: the covenant is deeply embroiled in mundane politics.

name: Protector
description: Covenant Hook: covenant is committed to protecting a village or supernatural place.

name: Road
description: Covenant Hook: covenant lies on a major road, river or sea route guaranteeing mundane contact.

name: Tame Nobleman
description: Covenant Boon: a nobleman fronts for the covenant's rule over its lands.

name: Urban
description: Covenant Hook: covenant based in a town, whose protections extend to mundane neighbors.

name: Writ of Crenellation
description: Covenant Boon: permission to fortify the covenant's residence.

name: Black Sheep
description: Story Flaw: character estranged from a prestigious family.

name: Close Family Ties
description: Story Flaw drawing the covenant closer to the mundane world through family.

name: Dependent
description: Story Flaw: character responsible for a usually weak dependent.

name: Enemies
description: Story Flaw: the character has enemies, such as nobles or senior clergy.

name: Favors
description: Story Flaw: the character owes favors that must be repaid, possibly with magic.

name: Feud
description: Story Flaw: the character is embroiled in a feud through familial obligations.

name: Heir
description: Story Flaw: the character is an heir, which a sheltering covenant risks interfering with.

name: True Love
description: Story Flaw: the character has a true love for whom they would do anything.

name: Faerie Queen
description: A vengeful faerie queen who curses a knight's fertility and lands for rejecting her in a story seed.

name: Iaculus
description: A large venomous snake with feathered wings that flies from trees onto victims; one found dead drained of blood and vis.

name: Alerion
description: Fabled bird with fire-colored, razor-sharp feathers that killed an iaculus.

name: Houses of Hermes: Societates
description: Supplement whose debate rules are used for Tribunal debates.

name: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages
description: Supplement describing House Guernicus factions.

name: Woodland Drake
description: A small drake dwelling in a Magic aura woodland threatened by assarting in a test-case seed.

name: Magic Aura
description: Supernatural aura of the Magic realm that helps magi cast spells; threatened by mundane clearance.

name: Bringing Ruin on One's Sodales
description: Hermetic crime charged against magi whose actions endanger the Order or other magi.

name: Interference
description: Hermetic crime of interfering in mundane affairs, whose interpretation is central to integration debates.

name: House Verditius
description: Hermetic House of craftsmen interested in profit; acts as a guild for its members and would benefit from selling more devices.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House already defending magi's rights to interact with mundanes, often reconnecting with noble birth families.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House combining idealism and pragmatism, ready to hunt the Marched; would benefit from mundane causes.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal at the heart of the debate on the Order's relationship with mundanes, home of the Ash and Apple gilds.

name: Ash Gild
description: Rhine gild seeking a bold presence in the world.

name: Apple Gild
description: Rhine gild seeking accommodation with and closer integration into the mundane world.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: War-torn Tribunal with its own view on mundane relations; not yet covered in ArM5.

name: Loch Leglean
description: Tribunal not yet covered by Ars Magica Fifth Edition, suggested as a place where interference is rife.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Tribunal not yet covered by ArM5, suggested as a place where interference is rife.

name: Bjornaer Septs
description: Divisions within House Bjornaer.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House focused on faeries, ideologically split; could support integration to protect faerie lands.

name: Encroaching Dominion
description: Scenario presented in Tales of Power, apt for approaching the Apple Gild.

name: Tales of Power
description: Ars Magica supplement containing the Encroaching Dominion scenario.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House most resistant to changing the Oath, which is deeply linked to Bonisagus and Trianoma.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder of House Bonisagus, creator of Magic Theory, to whom the Oath is deeply linked.

name: Trianoma
description: Founder figure deeply linked with the Oath of Hermes alongside Bonisagus.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House connected to the animal world, asking what it gains; may back integration to protect wild lands.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House focused on the Enigma; approaching it likely yields affirmative inaction.

name: Enigma
description: The mystery that dominates House Criamon's quest.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House of diverse traditions, many with deep bonds to the mundane world.

name: March
description: Hermetic sentence casting a magus out; House Flambeau hunts the Marched.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House of mostly unGifted redcaps with the closest relationship to the mundane world.

name: Redcap
description: Members of House Mercere who travel between covenants in the mundane world.

name: Dominion
description: Divine realm whose power and encroachment affect magi and faerie lands.

name: Magi Aegroti
description: Leper magi of House Tytalus, skilled healers specializing in Corpus magic and Longevity Rituals.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form of the human body, a specialty of the leper magi.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Knowledge Ability used to know House positions and to write polemic about the Order.

name: Code of Hermes (Ability)
description: Knowledge Ability on Hermetic law suitable for polemic texts.

name: Area Lore
description: Knowledge Ability usable for polemic on a given Tribunal with troupe agreement.

name: Durenmar
description: Covenant where the Grand Tribunal is held.

name: Primus
description: Head of a Hermetic House; the twelve Primi attend the Grand Tribunal.

name: Archmage
description: Senior magi of great standing who help decide Grand Tribunal matters.

name: Garus
description: Flambeau Primus, leading member of the milites, former mercenary and tournament champion; a potential ally.

name: Milites
description: Flambeau faction promoting chivalry and service to the Order.

name: Andru
description: Jerbiton Primus involved clandestinely in the mundane world; would support safe improvements.

name: Stouritus
description: Verditius Primus concerned with his House's wealth; favors selling more enchanted items.

name: Murion
description: Bonisagus Prima and Archmagus, unscrupulous and conservative; opposes changing the Order's founding principles.

name: Muscaria
description: Young Criamon Prima who opposes distractions from the Enigma.

name: Bilera
description: Guernicus Prima Archmaga, a negotiator healing the Traditionalist–Transitionalist rift; cannot support the change.

name: Falke
description: Young Bjornaer Prima tending toward isolationism through indecision.

name: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal
description: Supplement with more information on Falke.

name: Ebroin
description: Ex Miscellanea Primus, secretly a Magus Orbus of undetermined origin House.

name: Magus Orbus
description: A magus whose House of origin is unknown or lost.

name: Insatella
description: Mercere Prima, unGifted, focused on running her House and likely to abstain.

name: Handri
description: Secretive Merinita Primus concerned with faeries, surrounded by advisers.

name: Vinaria
description: Former Merinita prima who has returned and may have more influence than Handri.

name: Poena
description: Tremere Prima advocating a Hermetic state as in Transylvania.

name: Buliste
description: One of the two Tytalus primi sharing a single vote.

name: Harpax
description: One of the two Tytalus primi sharing a single vote.

name: Novgorod
description: Far-off realm whose kings may seek defense against the oncoming horde.

name: Iberian Peninsula
description: Region where Christian Spanish kings may seek magic to accelerate the reconquest.

name: Ireland
description: Land where English nobles may seek magic to secure their holdings.

name: Kosmokrators
description: Great magical spirits set to govern the turning of the world.

name: The Church
description: The estate of those who pray, controlling learning; its support, and that of the pope, is sought for integration.

name: The Church (supplement)
description: Ars Magica supplement supporting common ground between magi and the Church and originating the Proctor of Hermes seed.

name: Proctor of Hermes
description: A Gentle-Gifted Quaesitor representing the Order at the papal curia.

name: Papal Curia
description: The pope's court in Rome where a Hermetic proctor would present petitions.

name: The Pope
description: God's representative on Earth whose support would lend the Order great weight.

name: Commanding Aura
description: Supernatural power of church officials that a magus proctor must resist.

name: Guild
description: Associations of craftsmen offered as a model for explaining covenants to society.

name: Rego Craft Magic
description: Rules allowing a magus to imitate a craftsman via a Finesse roll at a higher Ease Factor.

name: Finesse
description: Ability governing the quality of craft magic, becoming vital for a new breed of craftsmen.

name: Affinity with Finesse
description: Virtue representing affinity for using enchanted devices.

name: Puissant Finesse
description: Virtue representing natural flair with Finesse.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of the fae whose spaces the Fourth Estate aims to protect.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of magic whose places and entities the Order would protect and represent.

name: Regio
description: Supernatural areas over which the Order would gain recognized rights.

name: Faerie King
description: Faerie rulers able to enter treaties in accordance with their roles.

name: Spirit of the Wind
description: Example spirit that might foster its son, as a swift horse, to a prince for dominion over mountains.

name: Grey Lady of the River
description: Example supernatural entity offering service in return for dominion over auras.

name: Rival Magic
description: Supplement presenting the Augustan Brotherhood.

name: Augustan Brotherhood
description: Gifted wizards following Virgil who serve Mythic Europe's nobility secretly as court wizards and oppose the Order's influence.

name: Virgil
description: Figure followed by the Augustan Brotherhood.

name: Polemic
description: Persuasive summa or tractatus explaining a philosophical position, circulated to build support before a Tribunal debate.

name: Diatribe
description: Critical text refuting a polemic; its quality is deducted from the Argument Total.

name: Apologia
description: Defensive text rebutting diatribes and strengthening the original argument.

name: Prevailing Wisdom
description: Level of entrenched opinion (3-15 by reach) which a polemic must overcome.

name: Circulation Total
description: Roll (reputation + summa level + die) to circulate a polemic to a Tribunal, House or the Order.

name: Argument Total
description: Text Quality minus Prevailing Wisdom Level, modified by diatribes and apologia; buys a debate bonus at Tribunal.

name: Summa
description: Book type with Quality and Level used for polemic, diatribe and apologia.

name: Tractatus
description: Book type treated as level 5 for polemics and limited in number per author.

name: Correspondence
description: Letters between magi that grant experience and may serve as debate testimony.

name: Reputation
description: Character reputation; circulating polemic grants Supporter of or Opposed to Reputations.

name: Order of Odin
description: Rival magical order treated as another House for prevailing wisdom.

name: Order of Suleiman
description: Rival magical order treated as another House for prevailing wisdom.

name: The Corruption
description: Historical event principally concerning House Tytalus.

name: Schism War
description: War central to the Order's history.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic theory whose origin largely concerns Bonisagus.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Secret Hermetic cults whose existence is a prevailing-wisdom topic.

name: Wizard's War
description: Hermetic sanctioned conflict referenced alongside military service.

name: Island of the Magicians
description: Chapter Three proposal to create a new land in the sea ruled by the Order.

name: Magic as Technology
description: Chapter Four proposal recasting magi as inventors and enchantments as technology.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Ritual ward listed in the book's political leverage section.

name: Hermes' Portal
description: Instant-transport mechanism referenced in inserts.

name: Silver Consensus
description: Principle restricting magical creation of wealth, enforced within the Order.

name: Cow and Calf Oath
description: Reason magical book copying might not work.

name: Rusticani
description: Non-Hermetic crafters of wondrous items.

name: Alchemist
description: Non-Hermetic inventors listed among learned magicians.

name: North Sea
description: Proposed location for the Island of the Magicians.

name: Frederick II
description: Holy Roman Emperor considered as a king for the island.

name: Isabella II
description: Queen of Jerusalem considered as a candidate monarch.

name: Philip Augustus
description: King of France considered as a candidate monarch.

name: Richard, Duke of Cornwall
description: Nobleman considered as a candidate king.

name: Valdemar II
description: King of Denmark considered as a candidate monarch.

name: William Longespée
description: Earl of Salisbury considered as a candidate king.

name: Patrick, Count of Dunbar
description: Nobleman considered as a candidate king.

name: Jon Haraldsson
description: Mormaer of Caithness and Earl of Orkney considered as a candidate king.

name: Eye of Hell
description: Infernal location in the island chapter.

name: Rumael
description: Demon known as the False Neptune.

name: Neqael
description: Demon, the Lady of the Purple Bower, Corrupter of Lyonesse.

name: Red Knight of Ys
description: Demon, bringer of requested inundations.

name: Lyonesse
description: Legendary drowned land corrupted by Neqael.

name: Manannan Mac Lir
description: Faerie king of the sea.

name: Dexithea
description: A Telechine.

name: Phorcys
description: Sea deity with an aspect in the book.

name: Tartessos
description: Ancient land that might emerge in a saga seed.

name: Quills of Arcane Correspondence
description: Example remote-writing device.

name: The Unsubtle Knife
description: Example device.

name: Earring of Whispering Voices
description: Example clairaudience device.

name: Hermetic Speculum
description: Example scrying device.

name: Effigy of the Errant Image
description: Example scrying device.

name: Superb Scrinium
description: Example book-copying device.

name: Gate of Countless Vistas
description: Example instant-transport device.

name: Phylactery of the Cautious Maga
description: Example escape device.

name: Potent Salts
description: Example wealth-creating device.

name: Garland of Prosperous Harvests
description: Example agricultural device.

name: Plaustrum Pertinax
description: Magical vehicle referenced in inserts.

name: Austerius Trianomae
description: Magus, opponent of change.

name: Protinus Velox
description: Magus of House Verditius, supporter of change.

name: Columbae
description: Group noted in the island chapter.

name: Warping
description: Magical side effects from constant magical effects or instant transportation.

description: Supernatural being listed among island inserts.
